exam.title: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite. Practice OCI image contracts, controller and multi-container design, ephemeral/persistent volumes, rolling/blue-green/canary delivery, Helm/Kustomize, probes/logs/debugging/API migrations, resource policy/configuration/Secrets/ServiceAccounts/security contexts, and Service/NetworkPolicy/Ingress paths on disposable clusters. Verify the official Kubernetes version immediately before study and scheduling.

review.notes: All five Kubernetes v1.35 application domains are mapped through one image-to-release-to-runtime-to-traffic lifecycle, with three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks. All ten guide URLs are cataloged: eight reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The August 26 v1.37 release creates a September 23–October 21 recheck window without moving the live v1.35 baseline, and the retired ingress-nginx controller is explicitly distinguished from the stable Ingress API objective. No proprietary simulator tasks, course labs or recalled exam tasks are used.

findings.title: Approximate version alignment is not a scheduled transition
findings.evidence: The live page still names v1.35 with no announced switch date.
findings.recommendation: Change unsupported scheduled metadata to none-announced while retaining explicit version watch.
findings.resolution: Change unsupported scheduled metadata to none-announced while retaining explicit version watch.

findings.title: Native sidecars differ from regular init and app containers
findings.evidence: Restartable init sidecars run beyond initialization and do not block Job completion after the main container finishes.
findings.recommendation: Correct shared-Pod lifecycle simplification; add startup/termination/readiness distinctions and stronger lab.
findings.resolution: Correct shared-Pod lifecycle simplification; add startup/termination/readiness distinctions and stronger lab.

findings.title: Ready is not always immediately available and timeout does not auto-rollback
findings.evidence: minReadySeconds defines availability delay; ProgressDeadlineExceeded reports stalled progress without automatic rollback.
findings.recommendation: Correct rollout explanation and add explicit observation/repair decision.
findings.resolution: Correct rollout explanation and add explicit observation/repair decision.

findings.title: Single-completion Job can start the same program twice
findings.evidence: Even parallelism1/completions1/restartNever does not promise one execution.
findings.recommendation: Require business-level idempotence and distinguish CronJob concurrency from shared locking.
findings.resolution: Require business-level idempotence and distinguish CronJob concurrency from shared locking.

findings.title: Merged values and rendered resources need different checks
findings.evidence: Schema validates final merged values; informational appVersion is separate from actual image reference.
findings.recommendation: Publish exact chart and execute defaults/overrides/zero/string/schema/reference tests; show faulty selector passes lint.
findings.resolution: Publish exact chart and execute defaults/overrides/zero/string/schema/reference tests; show faulty selector passes lint.

findings.title: Helm 3 support timing and major-version semantics need qualification
findings.evidence: June2announcement extends security fixes toFebruary10,2027 and identifies final limitedSeptember2026minor.
findings.recommendation: Date the exercised tool and version-sensitive workflow; do not infer assignedexamversion or test Helm4 migration.
findings.resolution: Date the exercised tool and version-sensitive workflow; do not infer assignedexamversion or test Helm4 migration.

findings.title: 403 can report quota failure rather than RBAC denial
findings.evidence: Quota admission rejects violating requests with403 and explanatory body.
findings.recommendation: Add original quota arithmetic and effective request/default distinction.
findings.resolution: Add original quota arithmetic and effective request/default distinction.

findings.title: Pod token automount setting overrides ServiceAccount setting
findings.evidence: Explicit Pod value takes precedence; automatic mounting and permission grants are separate concerns.
findings.recommendation: Teach actual Pod/audience evidence and avoid treating automount false as RBAC removal.
findings.resolution: Teach actual Pod/audience evidence and avoid treating automount false as RBAC removal.

findings.title: EndpointSlice membership does not imply readiness
findings.evidence: Unready or terminating endpoint addresses can be listed with conditions.
findings.recommendation: Correct Service and knowledge-check explanations; separate empty slices from unusable listed endpoints.
findings.resolution: Correct Service and knowledge-check explanations; separate empty slices from unusable listed endpoints.

findings.title: Changing apiVersion alone can miss schema migration
findings.evidence: Removed Ingress/HPA APIs require field changes in their stable versions.
findings.recommendation: Add concise historical migration table and retain live server/behavior validation boundary.
findings.resolution: Add concise historical migration table and retain live server/behavior validation boundary.
